{% tab title="Antigravity" %}
Install the Datadog plugin from the Antigravity marketplace. The plugin packages the Datadog MCP Server with bundled skills. For more details, see the [plugin repository](https://github.com/datadog-labs/antigravity-plugin).
**Note**: If you previously installed the Datadog MCP Server manually (for example, a `datadog` entry in your `mcp_config.json` file), remove or disable it to avoid conflicts.

# Important note for users on the following Datadog sites: app.datadoghq.com, us3.datadoghq.com, us5.datadoghq.com, app.datadoghq.eu, ap1.datadoghq.com, ap2.datadoghq.com, uk1.datadoghq.com
1. Install the Datadog plugin from the Antigravity marketplace, using either the CLI or the app:
- **CLI**: Run the following command:
```
agy plugin install datadog
```
If you're prompted to choose a marketplace, specify it directly with `agy plugin install datadog@antigravity-plugins-partners`. Run `agy plugin list` to confirm that the plugin is installed and enabled. Plugins installed with the CLI are also available in the Antigravity app and IDE.
- **App or IDE**: In the left sidebar, select Skills & Customizations (or go to Settings > Customizations). Open the Marketplace tab, search for `Datadog`, and click Install. If prompted, restart Antigravity to load the plugin's MCP server and skills. You can also open the plugin controls by typing `/plugin` in the chat input.
1. Run `/ddsetup` in Antigravity to connect the plugin to your Datadog account. During setup, select your [Datadog site](https://docs.datadoghq.com/getting_started/site.md).
1. Follow the agent's instructions to refresh the MCP servers, then complete the OAuth login flow in your browser.
1. Run `/ddtoolsets` to enable or disable groups of product-specific MCP tools.
1. After making any configuration change, refresh the MCP servers for the new setting to take effect. If the plugin stops working after a plugin update, run `/ddsetup` again to reconnect.

# Datadog MCP Server
Datadog's managed [MCP server](https://docs.datadoghq.com/bits_ai/mcp_server/) connects your AI agents to Datadog's observability tools and data. Query logs, metrics, traces, incidents, and more - directly from your AI-powered dev tools.
## Quick Setup
For Claude Code (US1 [site](https://docs.datadoghq.com/getting_started/site/)):
```
claude mcp add --transport http datadog https://mcp.datadoghq.com/v1/mcp
```
Many MCP clients also support configuration in a `.mcp.json` file:
```
{
"mcpServers": {
"datadog": {
"type": "http",
"url": "https://mcp.datadoghq.com/v1/mcp"
}
}
}
```
> **Not on the US1 site?** Replace `mcp.datadoghq.com` with the endpoint for your [Datadog site](https://docs.datadoghq.com/getting_started/site/) — for example, EU users should use `mcp.datadoghq.eu`.
The MCP server should work with any standards-compliant MCP client. See the [full setup docs](https://docs.datadoghq.com/bits_ai/mcp_server/setup/) for other clients, alternative auth methods, and regional endpoints.
## Automated Agent Examples
- [`examples/claude-agent-sdk/`](/datadog-labs/mcp-server/blob/main/examples/claude-agent-sdk) — Minimal agent using the Claude Agent SDK
- [`examples/claude-agent-sdk-advanced/`](/datadog-labs/mcp-server/blob/main/examples/claude-agent-sdk-advanced) — Monitoring agent that investigates issues and posts to Slack. Includes Datadog LLM Observability integration
## Links
- [Docs](https://docs.datadoghq.com/bits_ai/mcp_server/) - Full setup instructions, available tools, example prompts
